column3: Approve on a red-flag rule version is ஒப்புக்கொள் (agree, admit). This button brings a safety rule into force with a second doctor; the Tamil does not clearly say "authorise". The back-translation read "agree".
column4: Use one clear word for approve/authorise (for example அங்கீகரி, matching the status அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்டது) on the button, the dialog and the table.

column3: Approve an autonomy proposal is ஒப்புக்கொள் (agree, admit): same problem as the rule approval, on the switch that lets the system act without a person.
column4: Same word as the rule approval, chosen by the reviewer.

column3: Consent "Withdraw" is திரும்பப் பெறு (take back), the same verb used for revoke, withdraw a draft and "cannot be undone" elsewhere. Withdrawal is one click in the portal, so the word must be unmistakable.
column4: A word that clearly means "I no longer consent", chosen by the reviewer; keep it different from the rule "withdraw".

column3: Amendment of a result is மேம்படுத்தல் (improvement, upgrade). It suggests the result got better; it is a new measurement that replaces an earlier one, and it must stay distinct from "correction" (திருத்தம்).
column4: A word meaning "a newer measurement replaces the older" that is not திருத்தம்; the reviewer chooses.

column3: Hold (keep a slot for the current candidate) is நிறுத்தம் (stop, halt). A held slot is reserved, not stopped. The back-translation read "Stop".
Task kind "Referral hold" is பரிந்துரை நிறுத்தம் (referral stop). It can be read as the referral being cancelled; it means a referral waiting on a person.
Retired it (a rule version) is நிறுத்தினார் (stopped it): the same root as "hold" (நிறுத்தம்) and "stop". Retire and hold mean different things for whether a rule is in force.
column4: A word that means "took out of use", different from the one for hold.

column3: Withdraw this draft is திரும்பப் பெறு, the same verb as consent withdrawal and revoke; a withdrawn draft is closed for good and is not the same as retired.
column4: Keep distinct from the retire word and from the consent word; reviewer chooses.

column3: Acknowledge a grievance is ஏற்றுக்கொள் (accept). Acknowledging only records that you have seen it; "accept" can be read as agreeing the complaint is right.
column4: A word for "noted/seen" (for example பார்த்ததாகப் பதிவு செய்).

column3: Acknowledge this grievance? is இந்தக் குறையை ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளவா? ("Accept this complaint?"): same problem.
Alerts "Acknowledge" is ஏற்றுக்கொள் (accept): same problem.
column4: Same word as the grievance button.

column3: Tasks "Acknowledge" is ஏற்றுக்கொள் (accept): same problem; the action takes ownership of the task.
column4: Same family of word, reviewer chooses.

column3: Decisions in the reviewer statistics is முடிவுகள், which also means "results" and "ends". The back-translation read "Results".
column4: தீர்மானங்கள் (decisions), or keep with a clarifying word.

column3: That is the end of the log for this search ends with முடிவு, which also means "result": the back-translation read "this is the result of the record".
Abstention (the system declined to answer) is விலகல் (deviation, withdrawal); an administrator may read it as a deviation.
Developer panel "Development builds only" is உருவாக்கப் பதிப்புகளில் மட்டும் (build versions only); it can be read as production builds. The next string uses வளர்ச்சிக்கு மட்டும் for development.
Patient-facing status "Declined" is ஏற்கப்படவில்லை (not accepted): it can read as "the system did not accept your request" rather than "the hospital declined it".
column4: நிராகரிக்கப்பட்டது, or a gentler word for a patient; reviewer chooses.

column3: Staff table status "Declined" is ஏற்கப்படவில்லை (not accepted): same as the patient string.
column4: Same word as the patient string, chosen by the reviewer.

column3: Break-glass access is அவசரகால அணுகல் (emergency access): loses that this is an emergency override of privacy that is reviewed afterwards.
column4: Keep அவசரகால, and let the reviewer decide whether a short explanation is needed.

column3: Navigation "Break-glass" is அவசரகால அணுகல் (emergency access): same.
Add an addendum is இணைப்புக் குறிப்பு (attachment note); இணைப்பு can also mean an attached file or a link.
addendum to is இணைப்புக் குறிப்பு: same.
Patient-search "Label" is குறிப்பு (note); the label is a short tag, not a note.
Scheduling "Label" is குறிப்பு (note): same.
Scheduling column "Slot" is நேரம் (time), while the screens elsewhere say நேர இடம்.
Role "Patient" is நோயாளர் (collective, plural form) while most strings say நோயாளி (Part 4).
Metric "Index freshness lag" is குறியீட்டுப் புதுமைத் தாமதம்: குறியீடு here reads as "code", not "index". Administrator-only.
column4: Reviewer chooses a word for "search index".

column3: Offer status "No candidates" is பொருத்தமானவை இல்லை ("no suitable ones"). An earlier pass removed an election word; the sense "no one is ranked" is not stated.
Operating profile "Clinical" is மருத்துவப் பயன்பாடு ("medical use"); it means real clinical operation, as against the demo.
Register: patient and staff sign-in use the archaic -க imperative (உள்நுழைக), while other patient buttons use the bare imperative and sentences use -ங்கள். Part 5.
column4: One polite register, for example உள்நுழையுங்கள்.

column3: Register: வெளியேறுக (archaic -க imperative). Part 5.
Register: உள்நுழைக as a patient page title. Part 5.
Register: "உள்நுழைக அல்லது கணக்கை உருவாக்குக" mixes the archaic -க forms on the first patient page. Part 5.
Register: "வேறு எண்ணைப் பயன்படுத்து" is a bare imperative on a patient sign-in button; the sentences nearby use -ங்கள். Part 5.
Register: "எனக்குக் குறியீட்டை அனுப்பு" is a bare imperative on a patient button. Part 5.
